## Who is Abdullah Azmat?

Abdullah Azmat is an AI engineer and full-stack developer based in Pakistan. He designs
and ships AI agents, RAG-powered tools, intelligent automation, and high-performance web
applications with Python, LangChain, LangGraph, React, Next.js, Node.js, and MongoDB.

He is currently in his fifth semester of a BS in Computer Science at the National
University of Modern Languages (NUML) in Pakistan, holds a MERN stack development
certificate from PNY Training, and has built 7+ products. He has twice placed second at
the HackaForge NUML hackathons (HackaForge NUML 1.0 and HackaForge NUML 3.0).

## What does Abdullah Azmat do?

- **AI agents and RAG systems** — agent architecture, retrieval pipelines, tool use,
  evaluation, and deployment.
- **Full-stack web development** — React, Next.js, Node.js, and MongoDB applications.
- **Automation and integrations** — workflow automation, APIs, and third-party
  integrations.
- **Growth roadmaps** — a four-question business assessment that maps a 90-day plan
  across offer, funnel, Meta Ads, and follow-up.

## Selected projects

### Law Firm Intake & Client Management System (flagship)

A full-stack system that replaces scattered emails and delayed responses with one
structured intake workflow. AI-assisted intake captures enquiries, qualifies leads, and
routes them to the right person automatically. Includes a staff dashboard, practice-area
rules, and secure team access.
Stack: React, Node.js, MongoDB, Express, LangChain, OpenAI, RAG.

### LegalIntel AI (in development)

AI document intelligence for legal teams. Upload contracts, commercial leases, and NDAs,
then ask questions in plain English. Answers are grounded with exact page and clause
citations, with clause-level risk analysis.
Stack: Next.js 14, LangChain, OpenAI API, Tailwind CSS.

### Royal Venue (live)

A booking platform connecting customers with marriage hall managers. Availability checks,
venue profiles, and reservation enquiries in one visual flow.
Live: https://royal-venue.vercel.app/
Code: https://github.com/abdullahAzmat-art/Mariage-hall-booking-System
Stack: React, Node.js, MongoDB, Express.

### VORTX

An esports tournament platform with automated bracket generation, live match updates,
real-time leaderboards, and multi-game hosting.
Code: https://github.com/abdullahAzmat-art/vortex-esports
Stack: React, Node.js, MongoDB, WebSocket.

### Ayesha.a Collection

An editorial e-commerce storefront for a boutique clothing brand, with curated
collections and a mobile-first shopping flow.
Code: https://github.com/abdullahAzmat-art/Boutique-project-
Stack: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Supabase.

### NOVA Commerce (in development)

A full-stack e-commerce build covering product catalogues, cart state, authentication,
order processing, and admin controls.
Code: https://github.com/abdullahAzmat-art/Ecommence-Frontend-with-Spring-boot-Application-
Stack: React, Spring Boot, MySQL, Redux.

### Campus Lost & Found (in development)

A community platform for reporting, discovering, and recovering misplaced campus
belongings, with location tagging and claim validation.
Stack: React, .NET, MySQL, C#.

- Backend: Node.js, Express, .NET, Spring Boot
